primary.notes: Construction note: The end of the main cord has been cut or cut and wrapped.  This finishing may be intentional and the quipu complete.  At 19.5 cm the main cord has been repaired or joined to another piece of the same cord.

cords.name: p2s1
cords.notes: Two cord fragments were found associated with the first group of pendants.  They are both DB.  One is broken at both ends with a cluster of 2s at 1.0 cm from one end and an overall length of 3.5 cm.  The other has an overall length of 38.5 cm.  Beginning at its broken end, there is a cluster of 2s at 2.5 cm from the end then a space of 6.0 cm until a 1E and then 30.0 cm until a finished end.  These are probably parts of 2s1 or 3s1 or 7s4.
